name: aasb-aas-devops-cloud
description: Install the "AAS DevOps & Cloud" workflow plugin from Agentic Awesome Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Cloud delivery, infrastructure and operational recovery.
interface.longDescription: Cloud delivery, infrastructure and operational recovery. Prepare AWS or Azure infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, identity and secrets with validation, rollback and explicit deployment boundaries. Recommended for: Platform teams, Startup engineers owning deployment, Cloud and DevOps maintainers. Not for: An active incident as the primary task: use Observability IR, Cloud accounts, credentials or managed infrastructure supplied by the plugin. Covers Docker Expert, AWS Serverless, and 16 more skills.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the deployment target, infrastructure and CI configuration. Prepare the requested change using the existing platform, validate it locally where possible, and provide rollout, rollback and post-deployment checks. Keep production changes for the authorized deployment step.
Use this plugin to design a small-team cloud deployment plan with Terraform, CI, and runbook steps.
Use this plugin to troubleshoot this failed deployment and prepare an incident response checklist.

Review this project for the added coverage: Plan least-privilege secret storage, access and rotation without exposing values. Use only the relevant skills and existing stack. Report observed checks and limitations; prepare drafts before external or production actions.
